about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

corpus-map.json.note: #116 (docs/decisions/0026), on the map #117/#118 left (previousSha256). The manifest now declares the CFR's pointerPhrases, and the check found four pointers nobody had declared. They are answered by new crossReferences on night-operation, civil-twilight-operation and subpart-d-categories, and by a new scope: out entry, knowledge-recency (§ 107.65), which night-training-completed now depends on. It changes relations, so it carries an independent verdict. The reviewer saw only §§ 107.29, .31, .39, .65 and .100, a before/after of every changed entry, and the decision record; four rounds are recorded in the verdict file, the last on the bytes re-applied after #117/#118 merged. previousReview is that earlier map's review, unchanged.

previousReview.note: #117 (docs/decisions/0025) added assertedBy to all ten assertion entries and, where the party is named in § 107.49's lead-in or the corpus names nobody, a sentence to the note saying so. No other field changed. It is a semantic change, so it carries an independent verdict and not an exemption. The verdict file names these bytes and records two rounds. previousReview is the review of the map #61 left (previousSha256), unchanged.

#61 (docs/decisions/0021) added waiver-policy and waivable-regulations, and changed 29 entries' suspendedBy and crossReferences, on top of the map #100 left (previousSha256). It is a semantic change, so it carries an independent verdict and not an exemption. The verdict file names these bytes and records four rounds. previousReview is that earlier map's review, unchanged.

exemption.reason: Two changes for #58 and #59 (docs/decisions/0020), and no entry's meaning moves. (1) A top-level `extent` is added: {unit: section-designation, sections: § 107.25, .29, .31, .33, .35, .36, .37, .39, .41, .45, .49, .51}, the twelve subpart B sections the map README and blind-mapping/README.md already name as the slice. No entry changes. (2) operating-limitations' citation changes from "§ 107.51" to "§ 107.51 introductory text". Its evidence is unchanged and is the whole of § 107.51's undesignated lead-in and nothing else, so the citation names the same paragraph more precisely; check-locators-section.py verifies it against the lead-in only. No other citation changed: the other bare-section citations either quote a section with no designated paragraph (§§ 107.35, .36, .41, .45) or quote the lead-in together with designated paragraphs (§§ 107.25, .31, .33, .39, .49).

previousReview.note: compare.py read the map at 85e416f (40 entries) and exits 1 unless each of its 88 flags has a row in resolutions.json. The map was corrected to those rows in a5a4d66 (44 entries). sha256 is the corrected map; compared.sha256 is the map before correction. The same comparator run against the corrected map raises 68 flags; those have no rows of their own (blind-mapping/README.md, Counts).
